_comment: Hand-checked verdicts for disagreements listed by tools/divergence_test.py. Read by tools/divergence_report.py to annotate docs/DIVERGENCE.md. verdict: registry_error (registry was wrong, status fixed), library_error (registry verified against the exchange, the reference libraries are wrong) or convention_difference (both defensible, sources use different conventions). Every entry must cite the exchange's own publication.

entries.summary: Euronext's calendars for 2025 and 2026 close Amsterdam on Labour Day (May 1) and list Liberation Day, King's Day, Ascension Day, Whit Monday and the Dec 28 2026 substitute (Dublin only) as full trading days. The registry had them the other way round.

The Wiener Boerse lists Good Friday, Dec 24 and Dec 31 as closed (handelsfrei) and Epiphany, Ascension Day, Whit Monday, Corpus Christi, Assumption Day and Immaculate Conception as additional trading days. The registry closed the second group and treated the eves as half days.

The Saudi Exchange announced the 2025 and 2026 Eid holidays by the last trading day and the resumption day. The registry was missing 14 closed weekdays inside those spans, and 2025-06-10 as well (the libraries are also open on it, so it appears below as a library error).

The Saudi Exchange lists Founding Day as Sunday 2025-02-23 (closed), says trading discontinues at the END of 2025-03-27 and 2025-06-04 (both are trading days), and resumes on 2025-04-03 and 2025-06-11, which makes 2025-06-10 a closed day. Both libraries are wrong on all four. This is not a Hijri approximation: they carry the 2026 Eid spans exactly, but start both 2025 spans on the last trading day (2025-03-27, 2025-06-04) and end the 2025 Adha span a day early.

Euronext's calendars for 2025 and 2026 close Brussels on Good Friday, Easter Monday, Labour Day, Christmas Day and (2025) Boxing Day only. Ascension Day, Whit Monday, Belgian National Day, Assumption Day, Armistice Day and the Dec 28 2026 substitute (Dublin only) are full trading days. The registry closed those ten and was missing Good Friday on 2025-04-18 and 2026-04-03.

Euronext's calendars for 2025 and 2026 close Lisbon only on the common Euronext closures; Freedom Day, Portugal Day, Corpus Christi, Assumption Day, Republic Day, Restoration of Independence and Immaculate Conception are full trading days. The registry closed those eleven and was missing Boxing Day on Friday 2025-12-26.

The NSE and BSE 2026 trading-holiday lists close on Thu 2026-01-15 (Maharashtra municipal corporation election), Tue 03-03 (Holi), Thu 03-26 (Ram Navami), Tue 03-31 (Mahavir Jayanti), Thu 05-28 (Bakri Id), Mon 09-14 (Ganesh Chaturthi) and Tue 11-10 (Diwali-Balipratipada). The registry had three of them a day late (Holi 03-04, Bakri Id 05-27, Ganesh Chaturthi 09-15), Balipratipada a day early (11-09), a closure on Fri 03-20 (Id-Ul-Fitr is Saturday 03-21, so it is a weekend day) and was missing the election holiday, Ram Navami and Mahavir Jayanti.

The NSE and BSE 2026 trading-holiday lists close on Thu 2026-01-15 (Maharashtra municipal corporation election), Tue 03-03 (Holi), Thu 03-26 (Ram Navami), Tue 03-31 (Mahavir Jayanti), Thu 05-28 (Bakri Id), Mon 09-14 (Ganesh Chaturthi) and Tue 11-10 (Diwali-Balipratipada). The registry had three of them a day late (Holi 03-04, Bakri Id 05-27, Ganesh Chaturthi 09-15), Balipratipada a day early (11-09), a closure on Fri 03-20 (Id-Ul-Fitr is Saturday 03-21, so it is a weekend day) and was missing the election holiday, Ram Navami and Mahavir Jayanti.

NSE lists Tuesday 2025-10-21 (Diwali Laxmi Pujan) as a trading holiday and runs only a one-hour Muhurat session (13:45-14:45) on it; the next day is Diwali-Balipratipada. The registry keeps the day closed, like the exchange's list and like BSE (XBOM, where both libraries agree). pandas_market_calendars counts the day as open because of the Muhurat session. Both are defensible; no data change.

NYSE announced Christmas Day 2027 observed on Friday 2027-12-24 (closed all day) and no New Year's Day holiday for 2028, because 1 January 2028 is a Saturday. The registry had a Christmas Eve early close on the 24th and a closure on 2027-12-31. The New Year's Day recurrence rule also generated the 31st; it now uses fixed_with_sunday_observance.

NYSE announced Christmas Day 2027 observed on Friday 2027-12-24 (closed all day) and no New Year's Day holiday for 2028, because 1 January 2028 is a Saturday. The registry had a Christmas Eve early close on the 24th and a closure on 2027-12-31. The New Year's Day recurrence rule also generated the 31st; it now uses fixed_with_sunday_observance. Nasdaq follows the NYSE calendar.

New Year's Day 2028 is a Saturday, observed on Monday 3 January; the ASX 24 trading calendar for 2028 lists it closed. The registry had it open. The last business days before Christmas and of the year (2028-12-22 and 2028-12-29) close at 14:10 under the ASX rule and were missing as early closes.

Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve 2028 are Sundays, so the preceding Fridays close at 12:30, as the LSE did on 22 and 29 December 2000 (Stock Exchange Notice N49/00) and 2023. The registry had them as full days (a half-day mismatch, not a trading-day one).

JPX closes 31 December and 1-3 January only, so Monday 2027-01-04 and Friday 2028-12-29 trade. Marine Day is the third Monday of July (2027-07-19, not the 20th). The 2027 autumnal equinox is Thursday 23 September (the registry had the 21st). A Saturday national holiday has no substitute under the Act on National Holidays, so 2029-05-07 trades; the 2029 equinox falls on Sunday 23 September, so Monday 2029-09-24 is the substitute (the equinox date is a prediction until the National Astronomical Observatory publishes it).

The SEHK circular for 2027 (CT/077/26) lists the day following the Mid-Autumn Festival as Thursday 16 September (the registry had the 15th, the festival itself) and Friday 5 February, the eve of Lunar New Year, as a half day (missing). It names 8 and 9 February the third and fourth days of Lunar New Year; the registry names are corrected.
